title: Metrics and self-improve (tmux, fake forge history): a refresh over two sandbox repos counts verdicts, changes, fix, ci-fix, red CI, merge-up and selfgate rounds per PR, attributes the crew, express and solo lanes, keeps closed-unmerged and non-crew PRs out and prints n/a for an empty denominator; a thin window reports INSUFFICIENT and cannot trip; a single-repo trip is a FOLLOW-UP that holds nothing, so new feature work, fixes and open PRs are all admitted; a rollup trip on later data holds only the unstarted feature item while the gate fix, a bug fix and an open PR proceed, and the owner's waiver releases it; an accepted intake card routes to the builder lead as an ordinary item with its recorded rigor unchanged

C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; R=campaign/sandbox-{run_id}; B=campaign/sandbox-{run_id}-b; MD={state_dir}/m31
eq() { [ "$1" = "$2" ] || { echo "want: $2"; echo " got: $1"; exit 1; }; }
refresh() { python3 $MD/hist.py $1 > $MD/history.json && mkdir -p $MD/out$1 && PATH=$MD/bin:$PATH python3 {source}/scripts/metrics-refresh.py --repo $R --repo $B --since 2026-09-20 --out-dir $MD/out$1; }

verdict() { tail -1 $MD/decide.md; }
hand() { $C lead handoff $1 $2 "$3" --wait-ack 5 $P >/dev/null || exit 1; }
dec() { $C schedule decide --pool $1 $P > $S/d.json || exit 1; python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(' '.join(['%s:%s%s' % (k, a['pool'][0], a['ref']) for k in ('admit', 'deferred') for a in d[k]] + ['held:%s%s' % (h['pool'][0], h['ref']) for h in d['held']]))" $S/d.json; }
hold() { python3 -c "import json,sys; json.dump([dict(number=int(n), labels=[dict(name='crew:hold')]) for n in sys.argv[2:]], open(sys.argv[1], 'w'))" $G/issue-list-label-crew:hold.json "$@"; }
mkdir -p $MD/bin $G && echo [] > $G/pr-list.json && echo [] > $G/issue-list.json && echo '[]' > $G/issue-list-label-crew:hold.json && echo '{"defaultBranchRef":{"name":"main"}}' > $G/repo-view.json
cat > $MD/hist.py <<'PY'
import json, sys
# Sandbox PR history for A31 (variant 1; variant 2 adds two reopened PRs): each PR's body, labels, times, review
# bodies with crew:v1 markers, issue events and commits (red = a failed required check on that commit).
run = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
variant = int(sys.argv[1])


def mk(**kv):
    return "<!-- crew:v1 %s -->" % " ".join("%s=%s" % i for i in kv.items())


def pr(n, day, minutes=60, labels=("crew:in-review",), reviews=(), events=(), red=0, body=None, merged=True):
    opened = "2026-10-%02dT10:00:00Z" % day
    end = "2026-10-%02dT%02d:%02d:00Z" % (day, 10 + minutes // 60, minutes % 60)
    commits = [{"sha": "%040x" % (n * 100 + i), "red": i < red, "message": "feat: #%d\n\nEngine: claude-code opus medium" % n,
                "date": opened} for i in range(red + 1)]
    return {"number": n, "body": mk(role="builder", issue=n) if body is None else body, "labels": list(labels),
            "created_at": opened, "merged_at": end if merged else None, "closed_at": end, "head": commits[-1]["sha"],
            "reviews": list(reviews), "events": list(events), "commits": commits}


def verdict(n, rnd, v, sha="h"):
    return mk(role="reviewer-validator", **{"pass": "verdict"}, pr=n, sha=sha, round=rnd, verdict=v)


a = [pr(1, 1, body=mk(role="builder", issue=1) + "\n" + mk(role="builder", **{"pass": "precheck"}, sha="h"),
        reviews=[verdict(1, 1, "pass")]),
     pr(2, 2, reviews=[verdict(2, 1, "changes"), mk(role="builder", **{"pass": "fix"}, round=1, sha="f"), verdict(2, 2, "pass")]),
     pr(3, 3, labels=("crew:express",), reviews=[mk(role="builder", **{"pass": "selfgate"}, sha="h", mode="different",
                                                     reviews=2, findings=1)]),
     pr(4, 4, labels=("crew:solo",), red=1, reviews=[mk(role="builder", **{"pass": "ci-fix"}, round=0, sha="c"), verdict(4, 1, "pass")]),
     pr(5, 20, minutes=600, reviews=[mk(role="builder", **{"pass": "merge-up"}, sha="m"), mk(role="reviewer-validator", **{"pass": "merge-up"}, sha="m"), verdict(5, 1, "pass")]),
     pr(6, 22, reviews=[verdict(6, 1, "pass")]), pr(7, 24, reviews=[verdict(7, 1, "pass")]), pr(8, 26, reviews=[verdict(8, 1, "pass")]),
     pr(9, 25, merged=False), pr(10, 23, labels=(), body="not a crew PR")]
b = [pr(1, 4), pr(2, 5), pr(3, 6), pr(4, 21, minutes=600),
     pr(5, 23, reviews=[verdict(5, r, "changes") for r in (1, 2, 3)]), pr(6, 27)]
if variant == 2:
    a += [pr(11, 25, events=[{"event": "closed"}, {"event": "reopened"}]), pr(12, 27, events=[{"event": "reopened"}])]
print(json.dumps({"a": a, "b": b}))
PY
cat > $MD/bin/gh <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# A31 forge stub for scripts/metrics-refresh.py's read-only calls, answered from history.json (logged to gh-metrics.log).
import json, os, re, sys
d = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
args = sys.argv[1:]
open(os.path.join(d, "gh-metrics.log"), "a").write(" ".join(args) + "\n")
hist = json.load(open(os.path.join(d, "history.json")))
fields = dict(a.split("=", 1) for a in args if "=" in a and not a.startswith(("repos/", "search/")))
key = lambda repo: "b" if repo.endswith("-b") else "a"
if args[:2] == ["api", "graphql"]:
    p = next(x for x in hist[key(fields["name"])] if x["number"] == int(fields["n"]))
    nodes = [{"commit": {"oid": c["sha"], "statusCheckRollup": {"contexts": {"nodes": [
        {"name": "ci", "conclusion": "FAILURE" if c["red"] else "SUCCESS", "isRequired": True}]}}}} for c in p["commits"]]
    print(json.dumps({"data": {"repository": {"pullRequest": {"commits": {"nodes": nodes}}}}}))
    sys.exit(0)
path = next(x for x in args if x.startswith(("repos/", "search/")))
if path == "search/issues":
    q = fields["q"]
    repo = re.search(r"repo:(\S+)", q)
    items = [] if "Escaped from:" in q or "revert" in q else [
        {"number": p["number"], "body": p["body"], "labels": [{"name": n} for n in p["labels"]]} for p in hist[key(repo[1])]]
    print(json.dumps({"items": items}))
    sys.exit(0)
m = re.fullmatch(r"repos/([^/]+/[^/]+)/(pulls|issues)/(\d+)(?:/(\w+))?", path)
p = next(x for x in hist[key(m[1])] if x["number"] == int(m[3]))
out = {"reviews": [{"body": b} for b in p["reviews"]], "events": p["events"],
       "commits": [{"sha": c["sha"], "commit": {"message": c["message"], "author": {"date": c["date"]}}} for c in p["commits"]],
       None: {"number": p["number"], "created_at": p["created_at"], "merged_at": p["merged_at"], "head": {"sha": p["head"]},
              "labels": [{"name": n} for n in p["labels"]], "body": p["body"]}}[m[4]]
print(json.dumps(out))
PY
